name: Sneak
purpose: Fourth and inches. No handoff, no backfield action, nothing to mess up — the quarterback keeps it and falls forward behind the center. The whole play is the snap count.

LE.rule: Fire out into the man over you and drive him off the ball. If nobody is over you, close down inside.

LT.rule: Fire out into the man over you and drive him off the ball.

LG.rule: Fire out low into the man over you. Do not give one inch of ground.

C.rule: Snap and fire out straight ahead, pads under his pads. Everything depends on you.

RG.rule: Fire out low into the man over you. Do not give one inch of ground.

RT.rule: Fire out into the man over you and drive him off the ball.

RE.rule: Fire out into the man over you and drive him off the ball. If nobody is over you, close down inside.

LW.rule: Step up behind the end and push the pile. Do not go around.

RW.rule: Step up behind the end and push the pile. Do not go around.

QB.rule: Snap count only. Get under the center, keep the ball, and drive forward behind him. Do not stand up and do not bounce it outside.

FB.rule: Lead straight up the middle and push the quarterback forward. You are the second wave.

coaching_points: Vary the snap count all game so this one is not a surprise when you need it.
The quarterback stays low. Standing up turns a first down into a one-yard loss.
Never bounce this outside. If it is stuffed, it is stuffed — take the pile forward.
Run it on second and one occasionally so it is not obvious on fourth and one.
